title: Open Generative AI (formerly Open Higgsfield AI)
summary: An open-source multi-model studio for image, video, and audio generation that serves as a unified frontend for various SOTA models. It supports over 200 models including Flux, Kling, and Wan, featuring specialized studios for lip-sync and cinematic video production.
research_notes: The project is MIT-licensed but relies on the creator's paid Muapi service by default, though newer versions support self-hosted local servers for inference.

evolution.summary: Originally launched as a cinematic video studio alternative, the project was rebranded to Open Generative AI to reflect its expansion into a comprehensive platform supporting image, video, and audio models. It introduced a node-based Workflow Studio and added local model inference capabilities using a C++ engine.
